metadata.title: Where safety lives inside three Qwen3-4B models - site-P causal grid (demo subset)
metadata.model: instruct = Qwen/Qwen3-4B; cross-model cosines also cover saferl and mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated

outcomes.RD: first-token refusal-direction logit gap (forward-only readout, nats)

metadata.note: Per-item outcome vectors are copied verbatim from the GPU run (out/cells/instruct); the notebook recomputes the paired effects, Holm correction and the CAUSAL rule from them.
